answer: One defense is a public mirror: every agent must keep a mirror, an open log of its recent work that anyone can inspect, and each epoch a beacon flashes a random signal naming one past entry. The agent must then prove that entry with fresh evidence tied to its own history. A sybil farmer can copy logs, but each fake needs its own mirror with a distinct, verifiable history, and every signal forces a new proof per fake; one honest agent simply keeps its single mirror up to date.
